finding: The 4 JIT entries belong to the PME path, NOT to libgromacs. With PME on the GPU the full min+md run wrote 4 entries / 47471 bytes and GROMACS' md.log said 'PME tasks will do all aspects on the GPU'; with -pme cpu the identical workload wrote 0 entries / 0 bytes and that md.log line was absent, while the SAME -pme cpu workload under CUDA_FORCE_PTX_JIT=1 wrote 13 files / 13767931 bytes. The control is what makes the zero meaningful. Combined with arms A/B this means NOTHING in libgromacs JIT-compiles on the V100: both the nonbonded kernels and the rest of the min+md path load from embedded sm_70 SASS, and the only JIT on the machine comes from the independently-shipped CUDA library behind PME (cuFFT).
reproduction: arms A, B and C reproduced seq 8 (job 30) exactly - 0, 9 and 4 files, and byte counts 13486671 and 47471 identical - despite the singularity change noted below, so the baseline the attribution is measured against is a reproduced one rather than a single reading.
caveat: This attributes the JIT to the PME path by removing PME from the GPU; it does not name the library by reading its symbols. 'cuFFT' remains the mechanism inference, well supported (GROMACS reaches GPU PME through cuFFT, which ships its own PTX independently of GMX_CUDA_TARGET_COMPUTE) but not itself measured here. What IS measured is the disjunction the leaf's gate asked for: PME path, not libgromacs.
